description:
Fast, fully offline image description and an accessible overlay for windows NVDA cannot read. Everything runs on your own computer. Images are never sent to the internet.
NVDA+Alt+A: describe the current element
NVDA+Alt+W: describe the current window
NVDA+Alt+F: describe the whole screen
NVDA+Alt+D: describe the clipboard image
On a photo message in a chat app, or an image file in File Explorer, NVDA+Alt+A describes the photo itself.
Press twice for a detailed description in a window, where you can ask questions about the image.
NVDA+Alt+O: the overlay, a list of a window's texts and icons; Enter clicks an item
NVDA+Alt+G: automatic descriptions of images without a label, on or off
NVDA+Alt+B: names for buttons without a name, on or off
NVDA+Alt+N: give your own name to a button or overlay item
changelog:
* Fixed: the vision data download could fail with a certificate error (CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED) on some PCs. VisionMate now asks Windows to fetch the missing security certificate and tries again by itself.
* If the secure connection still can't be confirmed, VisionMate explains what to check instead of asking you to check your internet connection.
